ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-F in
the area bound by:

a line 248.7 feet north of and parallel to West 111" Street; the alley next east of and ~
parallel to South Halsted Street; West 111" Street; and South Halsted Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
